description: Capability for the standalone quick-launch prompt dialog window (v0.12.0). Deliberately minimal: it only needs core IPC (to call the app-defined get/submit/cancel quick-prompt commands), the ability to close/focus itself, and start-dragging. It does NOT get the main window's plugin permissions (updater, global-shortcut, autostart, window-state, notify, etc.). `notification:allow-is-permission-granted` is the one narrow exception — see `capabilities/miniapp.json` for why: `tauri-plugin-notification`'s `js_init_script` runs in EVERY webview unconditionally and self-checks permission via IPC with no `.catch()`, so without this grant it surfaces as an unhandled promise rejection on every quick-prompt open. It only permits READING the current permission state — sending a notification remains denied.
